vibe: Swiggy Instamart-style: chunky, high-energy retail, food-forward, saturated warm palette, playful micro-interactions, neo-brutalist edges.

typography.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule applies. NO Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Use Anton for massive, chunky, high-impact display headings (tight tracking, leading-none). Use Manrope for highly legible, condensed body text and dense data inside dashboards. Jump scale radically: H1 at text-5xl/6xl, Body at text-sm.

colors.strategy: Archetype: Vibrant Play combined with Swiss Brutalist structural grids. Warm cream backgrounds make the saturated hot orange (#FC8019) pop. The KDS should use a 'Performance Pro' Dark Mode (Command Center focus) for low-glare kitchen environments.

surfaces_and_borders.marketing_cards: Neo-Brutalist: Flat solid surfaces with sharp 2px solid black borders, 4px border radius, and offset hard drop shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]).
surfaces_and_borders.kds_kanban: High-density grid borders. Exposed skeletal grid with 1px border-border/40. No soft shadows. High contrast.
surfaces_and_borders.diner_mobile: Softer approach. Pill-shaped buttons (rounded-full) for 'Add to Cart', immersive edge-to-edge images, bottom sheet overlays using Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px white/40 border).
surfaces_and_borders.forbidden: No muddy transparent backgrounds behind text. No generic Vercel soft-shadow styles.

layouts.marketing: Mode A (Tetris Grid). Asymmetric overlaps. Use raw div/sections for organic spacing. Include a slow 'Editorial Ribbon' Marquee with massive text running in the background.
layouts.merchant_admin: Swiss Grid. Left sidebar, strict alignment. 1px borders separating all widgets.
layouts.kds_tablet: Mode B (High Density Grid). Kanban style. Edge-to-edge full viewport. Tight gaps (gap-4). Touch-optimized massive drag targets.
layouts.diner_mobile: Mobile-first, single column. Dish detail page MUST dedicate 50-60vh to the <model-viewer> WebAR interaction. Floating bottom sticky cart.

motion.buttons: Active scale down (active:scale-95), rapid hover states.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for menu categories and incoming KDS tickets.
motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly change text color and background for high contrast.

3d_libraries.strategy: Use strictly Google's <model-viewer> component to render .glb/.usdz formats for dishes. Do NOT use heavy WebGL scenes like R3F here—prioritize quick load, mobile-friendly WebAR.
3d_libraries.implementation: <model-viewer src='url' ar auto-rotate camera-controls shadow-intensity='1' style='width: 100%; height: 100%; background-color: transparent;'></model-viewer>

accessibility.contrast: Text on primary orange buttons must be #FFFFFF (or tested for WCAG). Avoid gray on gray entirely.
accessibility.focus: All active inputs and buttons must have distinct focus rings (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='checkout-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build out the multiple flows: Marketing, Diner App, Admin Dashboard, and KDS.
Embrace the 'Instamart' vibe—high visual energy, stark black text/borders on cream or bright orange.
The Diner mobile flow is the core experience. Prioritize an immersive <model-viewer> UI that feels fast.
The KDS should look like a command center. Kanban boards with draggable or tappable states.
Ensure the `<model-viewer>` component is dynamically loaded or initialized cleanly within React.
Use Phosphor icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for sharp, high-end iconography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Do not default to Vercel/Stripe styles. Push for creative tension.
Never apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add explicit transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped for consumer, sharp for admin) with interaction animations.
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn Dropdowns, Selects, and Calendars.
